name: Moody's Film Lab
dropBoxes: Porchlight Coffee & Records — 1517 14th Ave, Capitol Hill
Sonic Boom Records — 2209 NW Market St, Ballard
Bulldog News & Cafe — 4208 University Way NE, U-District
C&P Coffee — 5612 California Ave SW, West Seattle
Leica Store — 11111 NE 8th St Suite 130, Bellevue
notes: Envelopes and a dropbox are provided at every location — grab a coffee or a record while you drop. $17/roll develop + scan (C-41 and B&W), $23 for E-6; prints +$10. Scans arrive by WeTransfer. Negatives wait two months at the lab, or pay $7 to have them mailed back.

name: We Develop Film (Photo HQ)
notes: Fast, friendly counter. Also does prints, archiving and passport photos.

name: Panda Lab
notes: Long-running pro lab; archival darkroom printing and heirloom scanning. Call before shipping — mail-in is by arrangement only.

name: Ambient Film Lab
dropOff: 40080 SW Nelson Dr, Gaston — drop box only
dropBoxes: Chapters Books & Coffee — 701 E 1st St, Newberg
turnaround: Newberg box is emptied Tuesday mornings
notes: Small lab south-west of Portland, open since autumn 2025. Order and pay on the website first, then mail the film in or leave it in a drop box with the receipt. Scans come back by WeTransfer; returns ship USPS Ground Advantage at your cost. Price it out with the calculator on their products page, or call (503) 754-7899.

name: The Darkroom
notes: Mail-only, with a free prepaid mailer. From $14/roll develop + scan, $11 develop-only; E-6 and odd formats +$6. No ECN-2.

name: Speedy's 1-Hour Photo
notes: The closest quick colour turnaround in town. Tues-Sat; call ahead for anything other than C-41 35mm.

name: Tacoma Photo Center
notes: Nonprofit community darkroom. Have them process it, or book the darkroom and do it yourself. Open Thu-Sun 1-8pm; nothing new starts after 7.
